answer: Practically, the chain should require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because ridge only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
